moves.name: Bicep curl
cues: Curl with the bicep only. No swinging.
One arm at a time or both. Both work.

moves.name: Side lateral raise

image.label: real
image.alt: Dan at the top of a lateral raise

cues: Go light. Most guys need 5 or 10 lb.
Get your elbows high at the top.

moves.name: Overhead tricep extension

image.label: real
image.alt: Dan lowering a dumbbell behind his head

cues: Keep the dumbbell a few inches back from your neck.
Full lockout on top. Learn it with a light weight.
